name: PuzzleBloom
tagline: calm puzzle games for curious kids

/.title: PuzzleBloom — calm puzzle games for kids, no ads, no accounts
/.description: Quiet puzzle games for curious kids: twenty garden puzzles, an eight-colour theme studio, and no ads or accounts. Sudoku that explains why, memory, mazes, sliding tiles, and more — all playable in the browser.

/play/sudoku.title: Kids' sudoku with hints that explain the reason | PuzzleBloom
/play/sudoku.description: Free sudoku for children in the browser. Four levels, hints that teach the technique instead of giving the answer, and a creature mode for every digit.

/play/balance.title: Number balance for little counters | PuzzleBloom
/play/balance.description: A two-pan balance that never lies: read the numeral, count the frogs, and discover that equals means the same on both sides. For ages 4 and up.

/play/frog-road.title: Frog Road — some get on, some get off | PuzzleBloom
/play/frog-road.description: A car, a road of plus and minus squares, and two dice that never agree: one says how far, the other how many frogs. Eight turns of holding a running total. Ages 5 and up.

/play/bloom.title: Bloom Drop — merge a garden, ant to crown | PuzzleBloom
/play/bloom.description: Drop little creatures into a jar; two of a kind grow into the next, through nine friends from ant to crown. No timer, no losing until the jar is full. Ages 4 and up.

/play/shadows.title: Stone Shadows — three shadows, one plot of stones | PuzzleBloom
/play/shadows.description: A three-dimensional puzzle for children in the browser. Stack stones on a four-by-four plot until the three shadows a lantern throws agree with the plan. The front view cannot tell how deep a stone sits and the side cannot tell which column it is in, so only all three together fix the figure.

/play/nonogram.title: Kids' nonogram: count the squares, uncover the picture | PuzzleBloom
/play/nonogram.description: Free nonogram for children in the browser. Two sizes, hand-drawn pictures, crosses for the squares you rule out, and hints that explain the counting. No timer, no score, no ads.

/play/tangram.title: Kids' tangram: seven pieces, one shape | PuzzleBloom
/play/tangram.description: Free tangram for children in the browser. Drag the classic seven pieces into a silhouette; any arrangement that covers it exactly counts as solved. Hints that describe, never place.

/play/memory-garden.title: Kids' memory game: turn over two, keep the pair | PuzzleBloom
/play/memory-garden.description: Free memory game for children in the browser. Six, eight or nine pairs of the garden's creatures, face down; a pair that misses stays face up until you turn the next card, so there is nothing to be quick about.

/play/sliding.title: Sliding Garden — a 15-puzzle with creature tiles | PuzzleBloom
/play/sliding.description: Free sliding puzzle for children. Tap a neighbour of the empty square; the garden's creatures slide until the picture sits still. Three-by-three or four-by-four, no timer.

/play/maze.title: Maze Path — find the gate, no enemies | PuzzleBloom
/play/maze.description: A little hedge maze for children in the browser. Walk from the open corner to the glowing gate. A hint names the next step if you ask. Nothing here chases you.

/play/simon.title: Echo Bloom — watch the petals, tap them back | PuzzleBloom
/play/simon.description: A Simon-style sequence of four garden blooms. Watch, then tap the same order. A miss simply replays the same bloom. You can hush the chimes.

/play/connect-four.title: Four Flowers — gentle Connect Four | PuzzleBloom
/play/connect-four.description: Drop sun flowers against a kind neighbour's sky flowers. Four in a line, any way, finishes the bed. No timer, no scoreboard of strangers.

/play/word-search.title: Word Meadow — find gentle garden words | PuzzleBloom
/play/word-search.description: A small letter grid of nature words. Tap the first letter, then the last. Across, down or diagonal. No timer, no ads.

/play/lights-out.title: Firefly Lights — Lights Out for kids | PuzzleBloom
/play/lights-out.description: Tap a firefly and it and its neighbours swap light for dark. Every puzzle can be put out. A quiet garden is the whole aim.

/play/peg.title: Peg Pond — hop solitaire on lily pads | PuzzleBloom
/play/peg.description: English-board peg solitaire grown as seeds on lily pads. Hop a seed over a seed onto an empty pad. Undo is always allowed.

/play/flow.title: Flow Paths — join matching colours | PuzzleBloom
/play/flow.description: Numberlink for children: draw colour paths that must not cross, until the garden is filled. Drag with a finger; lift to stop.

/play/tic-tac.title: Tri-marks — tic-tac-toe with garden creatures | PuzzleBloom
/play/tic-tac.description: Three creatures in a line against a kind neighbour. You are the sun; they are the sky. They play well, but not perfectly.

/play/bloom-guess.title: Bloom Guess — a garden word, petals not gallows | PuzzleBloom
/play/bloom-guess.description: Guess a nature word, letter by letter. Hits fill the word; misses shed a petal. Six petals, no hanging imagery, no shame.

/play/reversi.title: Lily Pads — Reversi on a quiet pond | PuzzleBloom
/play/reversi.description: Place a sun stone so it traps sky stones in a line; they flip. A greedy neighbour plays the sky. No multiplayer, no strangers.

/play/jigsaw.title: Piece Garden — a simple jigsaw of a garden | PuzzleBloom
/play/jigsaw.description: A little garden drawing cut into four, nine or sixteen pieces. Tap two to swap them. When every piece sits home, the picture is whole.

/themes.title: Theme studio — make the puzzle yours | PuzzleBloom
/themes.description: Eight colours, and every tint, border and cell is re-derived from them. Contrast is measured as you pick, repaired in one tap, and shareable as a link.

/parents.title: For grown-ups: no ads, no accounts, no streaks | PuzzleBloom
/parents.description: How PuzzleBloom is built, and what it refuses to be: no ads, no streaks, no chat, no accounts, no analytics. Puzzles are generated on the device.
